 Home > News > Platform > Playstation Published 10:04 17 Nov 2026 GMT PlayStation Plus issues December free game update, last chance to play 100-hour RPG
 PlayStation Plus has confirmed another handful of games leaving the subscription service.
 Sam Cawley
 Follow us on Google Discover PlayStation Plus has already confirmed what games will be leaving the service in December 2026, and subscribers are losing a brilliant, 100-hour RPG.
 As usual, more games are being added to PlayStation Plus throughout November , even though most PlayStation 5 owners will probably be playing Grand Theft Auto VI anyway…
 Because more games are being added, it’s only natural that other games be removed to make space, but December’s planned departures are actually quite painful to see.
 Leaving the service are Granblue Fantasy Relink, Somerville, Fade to Silence, Dark Rose Valkyrie, Letter and PRISM OF EYES .
 Advert
 PlayStation Plus subscribers spotted these soon-to-be-gone titles on the Japanese service, which usually reveals upcoming departures before the rest of the world.
 It’s worth noting that the worldwide departure list could be a bit different, as different regions tend to get a different line-up.
 READ NEXT: PlayStation Plus secures my 2025 GOTY and it's a must-play for the Fallout crowd 
 Don’t sleep on this surprisingly short PlayStation Plus RPG 
 Now, the majority of these titles probably won’t matter to the majority of gamers, but Granblue Fantasy Relink is a devastating loss for the RPG crowd, and if you haven’t played it already, we’d highly recommend it. That’s if you don’t plan on playing GTA VI, of course.
 Granblue Fantasy Relink is a 3D action-RPG that was released in 2024. I’ve played it myself and thoroughly enjoyed it. It’ll appeal to Final Fantasy fans, but more so those who enjoy the modern releases like the Final Fantasy VII remakes. It’s very action-heavy rather than turn-based.
 Its synopsis reads: “A grand adventure in the skies awaits! Form a party of four from a diverse roster of skyfarers and slash—or shoot or hex—your way to victory against treacherous foes in this action RPG. Take on quests solo or with the help of others in up to 4-player co-op play!”
 Cygames, Inc. When it leaves the service, it’ll take all 132 hours of gameplay with it, but speedy players should still have time to start and finish it before it goes in December.
 HowLongToBeat reckons 132 hours is needed for 100% completion, but those who just want to experience the main story can get it done in just 15 hours. With a bit of exploration and side-questing, you’re looking at around 32 hours.
 That’s quite reasonable for an RPG, and ironically it actually sounds shorter than GTA VI based on what we’ve heard about its story length and open-world.
 Another recommendation from me would be Somerville. This one’s very short, clocking in at just four hours for those who want to fully complete the game.
 The trophies are also very easy to get, so if you’re a Platinum hunter, this could easily be your next score.
 You’ve still got time to play some of these PlayStation Plus gems before they leave in December, though the exact date of their departure doesn’t seem to be available yet.
